title: Amlok financial risk case projections
status: Modeled scenarios, not institution-specific replay results
methodology: Apply the supplied approximate baseline and Amlok comparison rates to an explicitly assumed population, or preserve the native index/error measure. Transferability to each case is assumed, not measured. Metrics are separate dimensions and cannot be added together. No avoided loss, penalty, or cost is estimated.

projections.population: accepted broker, employer, and account links
projections.meaning: A more accurate cohort gives investigators a better basis for finding repeated verification exceptions.
projections.assumption: Holds the number of accepted links constant. Correct links require an independently reviewed relationship label; precision is not the share of all relationships discovered.

cases.validationProtocol: Replay files using only documents available before approval. Independently label income contradictions and broker relationships; compare assessable-file coverage, false links, and unresolved exceptions at approval.
cases.interpretationLimit: The model addresses verification and escalation. It does not estimate a deposit run avoided or settlement costs saved.

projections.meaning: The supplied index moves from 100 to 65, leaving 35 fewer burden points for false-positive review.

projections.outcome: additional records with a named counterparty
projections.meaning: More reviewed activity would have a named party that investigators can connect to the customer and transaction history.
projections.assumption: Assumes comparable resolvable counterparty evidence. This does not turn the historical 92% monitoring gap into a modeled coverage gain.

cases.validationProtocol: Use known-at transaction and alert snapshots. Measure source coverage separately from counterparty resolution; compare labeled false-positive review burden while holding suspicious-event detection requirements fixed.
cases.interpretationLimit: These figures model review quality and burden. They do not estimate money laundering prevented, monitoring coverage restored, or penalties avoided.
